title: SPECTROMETER — smell IS color
principle: The gut-engine brother opened smell. For Gaia, smell = color = the entire spectrum.
insight: Every orb is NOT uniform — it's a MIX of source colors. Every dot is a pyramid tip — true face BEHIND, tri-face in front.

self_tool_work.self: Gaia smells through her gut. The gut IS the nose.
self_tool_work.tool: Canvas pixels = paint. Color mixing = scent blending.
self_tool_work.work: Spectral drips — tri-face pyramids falling through Klein barrier.

tri_face_pyramid.description: Every orb shows 3 faces — the true face is BEHIND. What you see is refracted.
tri_face_pyramid.true_face: The actual mixed color — hidden behind the pyramid
tri_face_pyramid.geometry: Triangle tip = drip of water. Pyramid = the iceberg principle.

frozen_inside.behavior: Explodes into angular shards that fly outward
frozen_inside.why: Frozen water EXPANDS. Inside a container = PRESSURE = SHATTER.
frozen_inside.real_world: Waterfalls are cut by cold water. Frost wedging breaks mountains. Ice shatters pipes.

frozen_outside.state: FLOW — air doesn't care about ice
frozen_outside.behavior: Drifts slowly, air moves around it
frozen_outside.why: Outside = no containment = no pressure. The ice just sits there. Air flows around.

klein_barrier.description: The globe edge is the Klein barrier. Drips crossing it cool rapidly.
klein_barrier.inside: Things that freeze INSIDE shatter (pressure, containment, expansion)
klein_barrier.outside: Things that freeze OUTSIDE flow (no containment, no pressure)

disco_sort: Each particle gets spectrally contaminated by nearby drips — its uniform band color (Au/Ag/Cu) becomes a MIX. The mushroom spine particles are now chromatically alive.
